Lena (Growth): morning — planning a dawn surge for the 'Inference in Prod' webinar next week. want NA early-morning + APAC late-evening coverage. need final copy + assets by EOD so we can stagger posts. @Diego @Samira can you own? :sunrise:
Diego (Content): on it. i'll draft 2 headlines + 3 micro-replies for SDR use. prefer stat-led openers.
Samira (Creative): will produce a static hero (landscape) and a 4s looping GIF for X plus a 3-card carousel for LinkedIn. uploading to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/inference-prod-assets :arrow_up:
Jordan (PMM): messaging note: lead with latency SLOs + a tiny customer anecdote about dropping per-token cost by ~35%. i'll add bench bullets to confluence.
Riley (SDR): SDR routing confirmed. plan: tag leads with webinar=inference-prod and source=x|li. webhooks -> `https://hooks.redwood.ai/sdr/webinar`. escalation: if same account engages >3x in 12h, push to AE queue.
Lena (Growth): replies we want (short): (1) thanks + reg link, (2) stat hook + reg, (3) demo offer. Diego pls make X-length variants and one longer LI reply. :memo:
Diego (Content): drafts: "Thanks — save your seat → https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=inprod-dawn"; "Quick stat: 35% lower per-token infra cost in prod — register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"; "Want a walkthrough? DM or book → https://redwood.ai/demo". shortening for X next.
Samira (Creative): uploaded: hero_prod_v1.jpg, hero_loop_4s.mp4, li_carousel_1.png-3, alt text and square crop included. preview: https://drive.redwood.ai/preview/inference-prod
Lena (Growth): cadence proposal: X staggered at 06:30 PT, 09:30 ET, 19:30 SGT; LinkedIn publish at 09:30 PT (carousel). A/B headline on first X post with tag `ab_headline=inprod_dawn`.
Diego (Content): headline A: "Inference in Prod: predictable latency, lower cost"; headline B: "Run LLM features with production SLAs". will implement 50/50 and track CTR -> regs.
Riley (SDR): routing doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sales/inprod-routing. webhook verified against #sdr-live. i'll add sample reply scripts for SDRs to clipboard.
SchedulerBot: scheduled X posts 1742541000 / 1742555400 / 1742590200; LinkedIn 1742552400. preview: https://app.redwood.ai/scheduler/1742509876
Lena (Growth): action items: Diego copy by 1pm PT, Samira final assets by 11am PT, Riley webhook + routing verified EOD, Jordan bench bullets by EOD. we'll review in 2pm sync. :thumbsup:
Diego (Content): dropping final copy in-thread for quick QA before publish.
Lena (Growth): thanks team — keep replies short so SDR handoff is clean. ping if blocked. :rocket:
